title: Mixed Event — Here on Our Dream Stage — Episode3 Allies Gather

meta.Event Outline: The schools of Shibuya are holding the Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival, a place for students to put on performances. Nene takes on the task of putting on a musical with students from other schools.

rows.Line: A few days later
Scramble Crossing
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...
The others really helped get my script together.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I still have a mountain of work left.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (For now, I need to focus on recruiting. I need a cast, songwriters, people to play in the band... I'm also gonna need costume and set designers...)
Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: M-Momoi?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I thought it was you!
Fancy seeing you here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Also, sorry if I startled you.
You didn't move after the walk light turned green, so I was wondering if everything was okay.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't notice at all. I have a lot on my mind right now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A lot on your mind? Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, nothing's bothering me...
I just have a big laundry list of things to do at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'm trying to figure out how to get through it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, can you tell me more about what you're doing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because it's easy to get stuck while trying to solve everything on your own, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Talking to someone else can help clear things up. So, Kusanagi, tell me what's on your mind!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Momoi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you.
So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
And you're trying to find people to join you right now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. The other planning committee members helped me make posters to put up, but I'm still having a hard time recruiting...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, being in a musical doesn't exactly sound like the easiest thing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I'm sure people will be interested after you tell them what you're doing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I just happen to have a few targets in mind!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... Would it be possible for you to introduce them to me?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure thing! I'll try asking my friends who play music or are in arts clubs!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...!
I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, let's exchange contact info!
I'll tell anyone who agrees to help how to get a hold of you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, no... It's just...
You don't have to if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But is there any way I could have you join this show's cast...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So... Do you remember the show we did on top of that mountain for New Year's? You seemed to have a lot of fun while dancing, and your ad-libbing was perfect...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, but I know you're really busy as an idol, so you don't have to if you can't...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You know, since you're offering, why not? I'm in!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? A-Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I'll have to check with Haruka, the others and our manager, but I should be able to pencil it into my schedule. We're actually a little free right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I really like the idea behind your musical. I think it's going to be wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The story of a girl who's encouraged by her musician friends to take steps towards making her dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: My goal as an idol is to spread hope to others, so that really strikes a chord with me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that. My friends and I worked really hard on this story...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, but I don't have any formal acting experience, so you'll need to show me the ropes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, I'll run it by our manager and the others. We'll talk again later! See you!
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Thank goodness... Momoi agreed to help.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I can't rely on her for everything.
I need to look for more people on my own, too.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(So, for now...
I should try asking some of my classmates.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Who else might be interested?)
The next day
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: ...which is why I'd like you two to join the cast of our show. What do you two think, Shiraishi, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you talking the show from the poster that's up at the entrance? I'm in! I really wanna join!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'd been thinking about it already, actually. Singing with kids from the other schools sounds super fun!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I appreciate you inviting me to sing with you guys...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm not sure how I feel about doing a musical. Really not my wheelhouse.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, good point.
I really can't see you belting an “I Am” song on stage, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Quiet, you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'm gonna have to pass.
But let me know if there's anything else I can do to help. These kinds of things always involve some kind of manual labor, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, would you mind helping us move stuff the day of? We're still a bit shorthanded there...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, no problem.
It should make for a good workout.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, you two.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Some of my classmates have already agreed to help design costumes and the set, which just leaves...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, do you guys know anyone who can write songs?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Write songs?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
If possible, I'd like to have some original songs to go with our original script.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, then, what about Toya?
He's really good at writing and arranging songs!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, he might be interested in writing songs for your show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks for telling me.
I'll try asking him later.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Writing songs for a musical...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
If you think I'm the right person, then I'll help.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's going to be my first time writing songs for a musical, but it'll be good experience for me to broaden my skillset.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank goodness... I really appreciate it, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
I couldn't help but overhear your guys' conversation.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?!
A-Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, do you plan on making your own costumes for this musical?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, that's the plan...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, can I also join the team?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? That'd be huge, but are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Absolutely!
These kinds of costumes always include a bunch of frills and lace, so designing them should be a blast!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see. Then, welcome aboard.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yay!
Toya, I know we won't be working on the same stuff, but let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I didn't think this many people would agree to help...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Now I'm really glad that I went out of my way to talk to them.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But there's still a ton left to do.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (For the sake of everyone who agreed to help, I have to keep on working hard!)
